objective: Verify P1-B dynamic runtime controls in a real persistent DSH/MCP environment without modifying repository source.
context: This branch is the clean merge preview of PR #12 head 17d3d0018a375ae0ad40899210949d8bec564a87 onto main b7cee7abe104dde64f3a9690c7f05d706fde15d2. Test the real activation boundaries implemented by PR #12. Use one persistent MCP process where the scenario says same-session. Any temporary Crew config changes must be backed up and restored byte-for-byte. Use a disposable Git repository for worker jobs. Do not modify DSH provider settings or credentials.
forbidden_changes: repository source code, existing tests, build scripts, CI configuration, package metadata, lockfiles, version or release metadata
persistent changes to ~/.config/dsh-crew/config.json or any other Crew user configuration
changes to ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, provider model catalogs, provider endpoints, credentials, tokens, cookies, signed URLs, or secret environment values
changes to the user's real workspaces; worker execution must use a disposable Git repository
force-push, history rewrite, reset, clean, stash, or deletion of unrelated local changes
validation: Validate this Task Contract with node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs task docs/agent-tasks/ACTIVE_TASK.json before execution.
Record the exact source SHA used and take non-secret byte hashes of the existing Crew config and DSH settings before testing; never include file contents or secrets in the result.

Start or link the branch in a real disposable DSH profile and keep one MCP process alive for the same-session scenarios. Confirm dsh_worker_config reports runtime_controls.max_parallel and activation_boundaries, including max_parallel=live, collaboration_mode=next-workflow, default_effort=next-session, and hub_url/vision_enabled/imagegen_enabled=restart-required.

LIVE raise: temporarily set global max_parallel=1, refresh/read the same MCP runtime, start two sufficiently long async worker workflows in a disposable Git repository, confirm the second queues, then change global max_parallel=2 without restarting MCP/DSH and trigger the normal runtime refresh path; confirm queued work is admitted and no running workflow is cancelled.

LIVE lower: with two workflows active, change global max_parallel from 2 to 1 without restarting the persistent MCP process, start another workflow, and confirm it queues; confirm lowering never cancels active workflows and new admission waits until active count falls below the new limit.

NEXT WORKFLOW: in the same MCP process, change a persisted global routing setting such as collaboration_mode from a baseline that allows Flash to pro-only, then dispatch a new workflow without a conflicting session override; confirm the next workflow observes the new global routing while already-running workflows are not rewritten. Restore the setting afterward.

NEXT SESSION: in the same MCP process, change persisted global default_effort to a different valid value and confirm the current session retains its startup default while global_defaults reflects the persisted change; start a fresh MCP session and confirm the new session inherits the changed default. Restore the original value afterward.

Confirm Settings /config returns config_activation metadata matching dsh_worker_config activation_boundaries for the tested keys, and confirm the client build containing the Activation Boundaries settings surface loads in the disposable DSH profile without client-load errors.

Restore every temporary Crew configuration change byte-for-byte, stop/remove any disposable DSH profile and disposable worker repository created for the smoke, and confirm the original Crew config and DSH settings hashes match the pre-test hashes.

Write and validate docs/agent-results/v03-dynamic-runtime-controls-smoke-result.json with node .agent-workflow/validator/validate-contract.mjs result docs/agent-results/v03-dynamic-runtime-controls-smoke-result.json.
acceptance_criteria: The same persistent MCP runtime observes max_parallel increases and decreases with the documented admission semantics and without cancelling already-running work.
A persisted next-workflow routing change affects a subsequent workflow in the same MCP process without mutating an already-running workflow.
A persisted next-session default does not silently replace the current MCP session default, but a newly started MCP session inherits it.
MCP diagnostics and Settings config expose matching activation-boundary metadata, and the Activation Boundaries client surface loads successfully in a disposable DSH profile.
No repository source/test/build/package/CI/release files are modified by the executor; only the required Result Contract is committed.
All temporary local config/runtime artifacts are cleaned up and the original Crew config and DSH settings are restored exactly; no credential or secret value appears in the result.
Every required validation is reported truthfully using PASS, FAIL, PARTIAL, SKIP, BLOCKED, or NOT RUN; overall PASS is used only when every listed test passes.
